name: Ritish Kc
title: SEO Content Writer
tagline: I write research-backed content that ranks on Google and reads well to actual humans.
aboutParagraphs: I’ve spent the last 1.5 years writing content that has to do two jobs at once: rank on search engines and keep readers engaged. That means every piece starts with research, not typing.
I’ve written for e-commerce, hardware & home improvement, travel & tourism, education, hospitality, technology, automotive, and healthcare, adapting quickly to different industries and audiences.
My process covers keyword research, search intent, competitor analysis, on-page SEO, internal linking, meta optimization, and content optimization using tools like SEMrush and CognitiveSEO.
